[B] Diagram
|
|-- stored inside DiagramRevision.diagram
|   `-- UUID id / diagramId / parentId? / nodeRefs
|
|-- id / revision
|-- content: DiagramContent
|   |-- revisionId             <contentId>:<revision>
|   |-- ascii / asciiSha256
|   `-- structure
|       |-- kind: diagram      unstructured ASCII
|       `-- kind: tree
|           |-- parserVersion  ascii-tree-1
|           |-- rootIds[]
|           `-- nodes[id]: DiagramContentNode
|               |-- label / line / branchColumn
|               |-- startColumn / endColumn
|               |-- parentId? / childIds[]
|               `-- foldRanges[]
|
`-- sourceContext: DiagramSourceContext
    |-- contentHash            tied to this ASCII
    |-- binding?               per-diagram source
    |   |-- sourceId / repositoryIdentity
    |   `-- corpus / domainProfileId
    |-- mappings[]             entityId + sourceRangeIndex
    `-- evidence[id]           captured source ranges

createDiagram(...)             content + source validated
resolveDiagramContent(...)     returns diagram.content

diagramSource(diagram)          mappings / selection / search
resolveDiagramSource(...)      source reads / definitions
                               selection / chat / compaction

Project no longer selects one repository for the canvas.
Evidence belongs to DiagramSourceContext.
Selection nodes are derived, not stored in the document.
